title: Mouse clicks not registered in renderer process on macOS Tahoe 26.5 (dev mode)
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

38.8.6

### What operating system(s) are you using?

macOS

### Operating System Version

macOS Tahoe 26.5 

### What arch are you using?

arm64 (including Apple Silicon)

### Last Known Working Electron version

_No response_

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

I don't know how to test

### Expected Behavior

In development mode, mouse clicks are not registered in the renderer process on macOS Tahoe 26.5. The app renders correctly and all assets load, but no click events fire on any UI elements. Packaged production builds work fine.
Click events fire normally

### Actual Behavior

No click events registered in renderer

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

Rreference issue #48311 
Production packaged builds work correctly
document.querySelector('button').click() via devtools console does trigger click handlers
window.getComputedStyle(el).pointerEvents returns 'auto' on all elements
Issue started after updating to macOS Tahoe 26.5 beta
Related to #48311 (macOS 26 lag issue) but distinct — no lag, just no mouse input in dev mode
